name: Anywhere devices into closing wordmark
looks: A laptop holding the live table game sits at a fixed shallow tilt beside a tilted phone running a different game, both glowing softly against a dark field. It cuts to the same assembled wordmark from the open, now with a bolder tagline and a URL caption, plus small platform badges beneath.
build: ui-tilt-card for both devices, same fixed rotateX/rotateY and slow one-degree drift, with their screens showing live DOM content. The close reuses wordmark-assemble's finished state rather than re-animating every letter, landing faster (0.4s cross-fade) since the mark already appeared once.
sound: A soft whoosh on the device cut, then a confirm chime on the final wordmark.
prompt: Close by proving the product travels: hold it running live on a laptop and a phone, both at a fixed gentle tilt against a dark field, then cut to the brand's finished mark with a sharper tagline, a URL and small platform badges as the sign-off.
